openCursor.cli.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer installed agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini CLI) in the model picker. They run on your own subscription.

openCursor.cli.paths.markdownDescription: Explicit binary paths when auto-detection fails, e.g. `{ "claude-code": "~/.local/bin/claude", "codex": "/opt/homebrew/bin/codex", "grok": "~/.local/bin/grok", "gemini-cli": "/opt/homebrew/bin/gemini" }`.

openCursor.cli.claudeCode.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra command line arguments appended to every `claude` run, e.g. `["--effort", "high"]`.

openCursor.cli.codex.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra command line arguments appended to every `codex exec` run, e.g. `["-c", "model_reasoning_effort=\"high\""]`.

openCursor.cli.grok.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra command line arguments appended to every `grok` run, e.g. `["--reasoning-effort", "high"]`.

openCursor.cli.gemini.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra command line arguments appended to every `gemini` run.
